title: pouteria pseudoracemosa
intro: Pouteria pseudoracemosa, commonly known as the  white sapote tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Sapotaceae. It is native to Mexico and Central America, and its fruit, seeds, and leaves have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The white sapote tree is known to have anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, pain relief, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria pseudoracemosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
